source: MSI D:\Taiwan stock\standalone-v1\data\intraday\archive (TAIFEX official tick -> 5m, day+night)
primaryAnalysis: All sessions (DAY+NIGHT) pooled, 10 cells, Holm across 10, BASE_2_TICKS_PER_SIDE cost, same-session-hour random control.
secondaryDescriptiveOnly: first half vs second half of training window
decisionRule: A cell is a candidate only if pHolm<0.05 AND meanRNet>0 AND day-cluster 95% CI lower bound >0 AND n>=100. Candidates are not tradable; they become a single pre-registered hypothesis for forward/holdout testing.
knownCaveat: This training window has already been used by ~30 earlier CRU-60 hypotheses (different rules). Results are exploratory.
